description.p: Collect class notes, work through equations and sketch ideas in notebooks. Keep your notebooks in local storage and process AI recognition on your device.

ul.li: Combine rich text, handwriting, tables, pictures and shapes on a free-form infinite canvas.
Draw with configurable pens, pressure sensitivity and smoothing, with one-to-one AndroidX Ink parity through ByteInk and performant ink rendering (7 ms with over 10,000 strokes).
Write inline and free-form LaTeX equations with native rendering.
Recognize handwriting and formulas on your device, with tools for solving, evaluating and graphing math.
Find notebook content with fuzzy search across text, tables, handwriting and text in images, using on-device OCR.
Choose ruled, dotted, hexagonal or grid paper in multiple sizes.
Protect your work with automatic database snapshots and restore earlier page revisions.
Export pages to PDF and transfer notebooks using the open-source .vive export file format.
Adjust display scaling for high-DPI screens, including 1440p and 4K displays.
Work with hardware keyboard shortcuts and configurable stylus button mappings.

description.p: Notebooks are stored locally and can be edited offline. Handwriting and picture text recognition are built in. The UniMERNet Small math recognition model downloads automatically on first run (about 209 MB). Other formula recognition models are optional. The Flathub package includes the math runtime; other packages may download it on first run.
Linux desktop version with notebooks, rich text, handwriting and PDF export.
